views.markdown: Unofficial English, Russian and Ukrainian localization of Zone by iosdump (iosdumpzzz). Translation helper by RAtnik00. Original Zone 2.1.0 executables are unchanged.

### Zone 2.1.0
- Fixed the Lock Screen poster panel when double-tap-to-lock is disabled.
- Fixed a black screen when enabled without a selected wallpaper.
- Added video-loop controls for the Lock Screen and Home Screen.
- Updated the settings UI and fixed other bugs.

### Compatibility
Upstream lists support for iOS 14–17. This repository package targets rootless `iphoneos-arm64` (`/var/jb`); actual compatibility depends on the jailbreak environment. Requires a compatible jailbreak with tweak injection and PreferenceLoader.

### Translation
The author/channel/icon/repository credits under the Zone icon and the available settings strings are translated into English, Russian and Ukrainian. Language follows the iPhone system language.

- Fixed the Lock Screen poster panel when double-tap-to-lock is disabled.
- Fixed the black-screen issue when enabled before selecting wallpaper.
- Added separate Lock Screen and Home Screen video-loop controls.
- Updated the settings UI and included other fixes.

- Translated the multi-line credits under the icon while preserving clickable author links.
- Set the package name to Zone and added the Zone icon supplied by the original author to package details.
